header.shortDesc: Braces change everything about how you clean your teeth. The ULTIM8 Ortho SmartBrush System was engineered by orthodontists for patients in treatment, combining patented SuperBristles® Ortho that wrap around brackets, wires, and attachments with the SmartHub’s UV sanitizing, automatic drying, and wireless charging. The result: a brush that’s always clean, fully charged, and performing up to an incredible 60 times more effectively than a manual brush where it matters most.
header.superHtml:
🏆Named “Best for Braces” by Health.com — and recognized across leading health and wellness publications — this is the only brush built from the ground up for orthodontic treatment.

Key Benefits at a Glance

✓ SuperBristles® Ortho — patented bristle architecture engineered for braces, ISO-verified up to 60x cleaner than a manual brush around orthodontic hardware

✓ Four sonic brushing modes including dedicated Ortho mode

✓ Pressure sensor to help protect teeth and gums throughout treatment

✓ SmartTimer™ with 30-second quadrant reminders

✓ SmartHub™ UV sanitizing, automatic drying, and wireless charging

✓ SmartCase™ travel UV sanitizing and wireless charging (optional)

✓ System that grows with you — switches to SuperBristles® Pro or Pro-mini after treatment, same brush for life

Protect Your Orthodontic Investment

Clinical research shows that between 30% and 50% of orthodontic patients develop white spot lesions during treatment — permanent enamel damage caused by plaque trapped around brackets and wires. Orthodontic patients face elevated cavity risk as well. The right toothbrush doesn’t just clean teeth. During treatment, it actively protects the outcome you’re working toward.

Why Choose the ULTIM8® Ortho SmartBrush System?

Patented SuperBristles®Ortho
No bristles before had been engineered to wrap around the three-dimensional geometry of brackets, wires, and attachments — until SuperBristles® Ortho. Three times more bristles than the industry norm. Super-soft PBT bristles that are inherently gentler than nylon and become more adaptive with use rather than splaying. ISO-verified to clean up to 60 times more effectively than a manual brush around orthodontic hardware.

Four Sonic Modes + a System That Grows With You
Ortho mode is co-engineered with SuperBristles® Ortho to deliver the full 60x cleaning advantage. Sensitive mode is ideal on tender days after adjustments. After treatment, swap brush heads for SuperBristles® Pro or Pro-mini — same handle, new chapter. Replace brush heads every 6 weeks for optimal performance.

Pressure Sensor — Protect What You're Investing In
The real-time pressure sensor indicator light alerts you the moment you’re pressing too hard, protecting enamel and gums throughout treatment. Studies suggest most brushers apply more pressure than recommended. The Ortho SmartBrush makes sure you’re not among them.

SmartHub® — Your Brush's Home
After every brush, your ULTIM8 Ortho lives in the SmartHub. UV sanitizer eliminates 99.9% of germs in 5 minutes. Integrated dryer removes moisture between uses. Wireless charging keeps your brush powered. Indicator lights designed to avoid disrupting melatonin production during nighttime bathroom visits.

SmartCase® — Traveling Made Easy
Built-in UV sanitizing and wireless charging keep your brush protected and powered on the go. Custom compartments store SuperMouth travel toothpaste and floss. Your full ortho routine, wherever you are.

SmartTimer
30-second quadrant vibration pulses ensure every area around your hardware gets equal attention. Auto shut-off after two minutes. Proper technique, made automatic.

Waterproof — IPX7 | Designed for All Orthodontic Appliances
Traditional braces, ceramic braces, lingual braces, clear aligners with attachments, expanders, retainers — if orthodontic hardware is part of your daily life, this is your brush.

Orthodontist Recommended

What to Look for in the Best Electric Toothbrush for Braces

When choosing an electric toothbrush for braces, orthodontists typically recommend:

A brush head specifically engineered for brackets and wires — not just marketed as braces-compatible
Ultra-soft bristles that protect enamel and gum tissue throughout treatment
Multiple brushing modes, including a dedicated mode for orthodontic hardware
A pressure sensor to prevent overbrushing
A built-in timer with quadrant reminders
A system for keeping the brush clean between uses

The ULTIM8 Ortho SmartBrush System was engineered to meet every one of these criteria — with patented technology and ISO-verified performance data behind each claim.

items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Should Invisalign patients use the Ortho Edition or Signature Edition?
The Ortho Edition. Clear aligner patients have composite attachments bonded to their teeth that create similar geometry to brackets. SuperBristles® Ortho are engineered to clean around those attachments. The Ortho Edition is the right choice for any patient with hardware on their teeth.
What other orthodontic appliances does the Ortho Edition work with?
Traditional metal braces, ceramic braces, lingual braces, clear aligners with attachments, expanders, retainers, and other fixed or removable appliances. If you have hardware in your mouth as part of orthodontic treatment, this is your brush.
How often should I replace my Ortho brush heads?
Every 6 weeks — the same recommendation for all SuperMouth brush heads. Subscribing to automatic replacements ensures you're always brushing at full performance and qualifies you for the Lifetime Warranty.
What is Ortho mode and how is it different from the other modes?
Ortho mode is a sonic frequency specifically calibrated to work with SuperBristles® Ortho. The two are co-engineered — Ortho mode drives the patented bristle architecture into spaces other brushes can't reach, delivering the full up-to-60x cleaning advantage. The other modes: Super (high-vibration polish), Sensitive (tender post-adjustment days), Smart (pressure-adaptive).
What happens after my orthodontic treatment is finished?
Your SmartBrush, SmartHub, and SmartCase stay exactly as they are. Simply switch your SuperBristles® Ortho heads for SuperBristles® Pro or Pro-mini, optimized for teeth without hardware. One investment, a lifetime of use.
Can I use Ortho mode with standard (non-Ortho) brush heads?
You can, but you won't get the full benefit. Ortho mode is optimized for SuperBristles® Ortho geometry. For maximum cleaning around orthodontic hardware, always pair Ortho mode with SuperBristles® Ortho heads.
Should I use the SuperMouth Ortho toothpaste, mouthwash, and floss with this system?
Yes. SuperMouth's Ortho toothpaste, mouthwash, and floss are formulated specifically for patients in treatment and designed to work together with the Ortho SmartBrush System — giving you layered protection against cavities, white spot lesions, plaque buildup, and gum sensitivity.
Is this suitable for children in braces?
Yes, with adult supervision recommended for younger children. The pressure sensor and SmartTimer make it easier for kids to brush correctly — especially valuable during treatment when technique matters most.
Is the ULTIM8 Ortho SmartBrush a sonic toothbrush?
Yes. What makes it different is the combination of SuperBristles® Ortho with a dedicated Ortho sonic mode co-engineered to drive those bristles into spaces around brackets, wires, and attachments — delivering ISO-verified cleaning performance up to 60x greater than a manual brush.
Does the toothbrush connect to an app?
No. The ULTIM8 SmartBrush is designed around real-time, in-handle feedback — the pressure sensor light, SmartTimer pulses, and mode indicator deliver guidance during brushing with no phone required.
Is this toothbrush good for ceramic braces or lingual braces?
Yes, and particularly well suited to both. Ceramic brackets can stain if plaque isn't consistently cleared from bracket margins; lingual braces sit on the inner tooth surface where standard brush heads struggle to reach. SuperBristles® Ortho's patented architecture wraps around all bracket types. The pressure sensor is especially valuable for ceramic bracket patients.
Is this a good electric toothbrush for teens and tweens in braces?
Yes — teens and tweens benefit most from the smart features. The pressure sensor provides real-time feedback that helps younger patients break overbrushing habits. The SmartTimer ensures equal time on each area. The SmartHub's UV sanitizer eliminates germs that accumulate in shared bathrooms. Adult supervision recommended for younger teens and preteens.
What is the difference between PBT bristles and nylon bristles?
Most bristles, including many marketed as "soft," are made from nylon, which remains relatively rigid and can be abrasive against enamel and gum tissue. PBT (polybutylene terephthalate) bristles are softer and more flexible at equivalent diameters, absorb less moisture, and become more adaptive with use rather than splaying. For orthodontic patients — with more sensitive gum tissue and enamel under elevated stress — PBT bristles provide a meaningfully gentler clean without sacrificing plaque removal.
